act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the provisions relating to offences and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

classification.bailable: According as offence is bailable or non-is bailable.
classification.cognizable: According as offence is cognizable or non-cognizable.
classification.offence: Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object.
classification.punishment: The same as for the offence.
classification.triable_by: The Court by which the offence triable.

section.heading: Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object
section.html: If an offence is committed by any member of an unlawful assembly in prosecution of the common object of that assembly, or such as the members of that assembly knew to be likely to be committed in prosecution of that object, every person who, at the time of the committing of that offence, is a member of the same assembly, is guilty of that offence.
